items.title: New Chapter, Same Stalemate: Somalia’s War with Al-Shabaab
items.description: The Somali government’s battle with Al-Shabaab militants grinds on, with neither able to gain a decisive advantage. To improve its lot, Mogadishu needs to bolster its military and alleviate civilian suffering in areas under insurgent control, while looking for openings for dialogue with the group.
items.titleIt: New Chapter, Same Stalemate: Somalia’s War with Al-Shabaab

items.title: “Strategic Balance” under Stress: Egypt and the U.S.-Israeli War with Iran
items.description: Egypt has been walking a tightrope since the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran began, joining mediation efforts while signalling solidarity with Gulf Arab partners under Iranian attack. But with some Gulf capitals voicing expectations of stronger support, Cairo may find itself under increasing pressure.
items.titleIt: “Strategic Balance” under Stress: Egypt and the U.S.-Israeli War with Iran

items.title: Kenya: Portable Ginnery Helps Cotton Farmers Keep More Value on the Farm
items.description: [Bird Story Agency] A locally developed portable ginnery is helping Kenyan cotton farmers process their harvests closer to home, reduce losses and earn more by selling lint and seed separately. Its developers believe decentralised processing could help revive the country's cotton industry while keeping more value and jobs in rural communities.
items.titleIt: Kenya: Portable Ginnery Helps Cotton Farmers Keep More Value on the Farm

items.title: 28% increase in passports issued by the Italian Consulate in Dubai
items.description: (ANSA) - ROMA, 28 LUG - The Consulate General of Italy in Dubai reports that in the first six months of 2026, it issued 1,340 passports, compared to 1,046 during the same period in 2025. This represents a 28% increase. “This increase,” explains the consulate, “did not occur in spite of the conflict, but rather because of the conflict.” Furthermore, the consular offices remained open throughout March to renew expiring passports and issue first passports to newborns. Read article...
items.titleIt: 28% increase in passports issued by the Italian Consulate in Dubai

items.title: Italy 'books' SAFE loan of up to €14.9 billion, but EC says deal must be signed ASAP
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, JUL 28 - Deputy Premier and Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani said Tuesday that the government has reserved the right to take a loan from the EU's SAFE (Security Action for Europe) facility of up to 14.9 billion euros to invest in security and defence. Tajani stressed that the loan only has been "reserved" and that the government will decide by the end of the year how much actually to take, if any, as he reported to a joint session of the defence and foreign affairs committees of the Lower House and Senate over the recent NATO summit in Ankara. items.title: Govt cuts diesel duties by 17 cents to help with rise in fuel costs
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, JUL 28 - A 17-cent cut in diesel duties that the government approved on Monday to help people cope with high fuel costs following the return of conflict in the Persian Gulf came into effect on Tuesday and will remain in place until August 6. The cut will cost the State around 125 million euro and should bring diesel prices in line with those for unleaded petrol, the duties of which have not been reduced. Premier Giorgia Meloni described the cut as "a timely, responsible response" to the recent increase in fuel prices. The government has not ruled out further measures. (ANSA). Re
items.titleIt: Govt cuts diesel duties by 17 cents to help with rise in fuel costs
